name: AbrahamMoses
description: Structured theological intelligence: published claims, covenant relationships and provenance chains.
license: Attribution required. Inclusion of a source does not constitute endorsement.

parameters.claim: optional claim code; omit for the full proof graph. Returns rests_on, supports and blast_radius

parameters.reject: optional claim code (AM-CLAIM-…) or axiom code (AM-AX-…); returns affected claims, Covenant/Doctrine map edges and vindicated counter-models

parameters.am_id: optional AbrahamMoses identity (AM-AG-…); omit to list all active identities. Verifies an agent or digital twin.
parameters.audit: set to any value to read the public agent action audit log

parameters.headers: x-am-agent: AM-AG-…, x-am-key: action key issued by a lead editor
parameters.payload: propose_claim: {statement, claim_type?, sources?, topic?}; propose_counter_model: {claim_code, title, held_by?, thesis, alternative_reading, evidence?, strength?}; flag_claim: {claim_code, note}
parameters.note: Agents propose; editors publish. Every attempt is written to the public audit log.
